biotools.summary: WarpDemuX is a fast and accurate adapter-barcoding and demultiplexing approach for nanopore direct RNA sequencing (dRNA-seq). It enhances speed and accuracy by processing raw nanopore signals and enables barcode-specific adaptive sampling to enrich target molecules.
